title: How Sony Really Makes Money (It's Not Gadgets Anymore)
description:
Sony sold far fewer PS5 consoles in mid-2026, yet its PlayStation profit jumped 83%. In this file we open the money machine behind Sony: two engineers in bomb-damaged Tokyo in 1946, a rice cooker that failed, the transistor radio, the Trinitron and the Walkman, the Betamax lesson, buying CBS Records and Columbia Pictures, how Nintendo's snub created the PlayStation, the razor-and-blades console model, why music earns more than TVs, the image sensors hidden inside other phones, and the latest numbers.

{CHAPTERS}

Sources: Sony Group Q2 FY2026 earnings presentation (November 2026, via SEC Form 6-K); Sony Group FY2025 earnings presentation (May 2026, via SEC Form 6-K); Securities.io (Sony Q2 FY2026, November 2026); Gaming Amigos (Sony Q2 2026 results); Britannica (Sony); Commoncog (The Birth of Sony); Vintage Radio NL (Sony history); UPI archives (CBS Records purchase, 1988); The Christian Science Monitor (Columbia Pictures, 1989); Video Games Chronicle (PlayStation at 30, 2024); PetaPixel via Nikkei (image sensor share 2025); Electronics World via Yole Group (CIS industry 2026).

All figures are rounded. Dollar conversions are approximate. This video is for education only, not investment advice.
